title: SCHEMA PROBE A — v2.4 core unknowns
description: A deliberately minimal instrument world. Every field carries a PROBE marker so a re-export diff is readable. Not a playable adventure — do not publish.
background: A featureless white room containing a single wooden table. Nothing happens here unless a trigger makes it happen. This world exists to answer questions about how Infinite Worlds handles schema v2.4, not to tell a story.
instructions: This is a schema probe world. Keep every response to one short sentence. Do not invent events, characters, or scenery. The player is expected to advance turns mechanically so that triggers fire.
objective: Advance turns so the probe triggers fire.

trackedItems.name: P7 Nested Yaml Enforce
trackedItems.description: PROBE P7: a YAML tracked item whose formatSchema nests a sub-map, with enforceFormat on. Used to test whether format enforcement recurses past the top level.
trackedItems.updateInstructions: On every turn, add one new entry with a made-up name and breed. Deliberately OMIT the stats sub-map on the entry you add, so that drift below the top level can be observed.
trackedItems.formatExample:
- name: Rex
  breed: terrier
  stats:
    friendliness: 5
    energy: 10
  colour: brindle
trackedItems.formatSchema:
- name: text
  breed: text
  stats:
    friendliness: number
    energy: number
    ...:
  colour: text
  ...:
